[[Etnaran Keys (Luxon)|Etnaran Keys]] is one of five outposts used for entering [[Alliance battle]]s from the [[Luxon]] side.

==Getting there==
Speak to a [[Luxon Navigator]] at a Luxon [[guild hall]] when the [[Kurzick-Luxon border]] is in Luxon territory.
